title: Travel Insurance
intro: International travel insurance pays for medical emergencies, lost baggage and delays abroad; what matters most is the medical cover limit, whether pre-existing conditions are covered in an emergency, and the deductibles you pay per claim.
sources: Insurer product pages, brochures, prospectuses and customer information sheets (Oct 2026)

HDFC ERGO Explorer prospectus and filed rate chart; SBI General travel prospectus; IFFCO Tokio Overseas Travel Protector prospectus and CIS; Zurich Kotak Smart Travel prospectus; Generali Central Jet Set Secure brochure; Niva Bupa TravelAssure brochure and policy wording
nriol.com, PolicyBazaar and eindiainsurance.com plan pages (where insurer sites were unavailable)
Ditto Health Insurance Data Lab (Sep 2026), compiled from insurer public disclosures (health claim settlement ratio)
IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 (Statement 12, solvency ratios as at 31 Mar 2025)

params.label: Max medical cover (USD)
params.tip: Highest medical sum insured offered on the plan's top variant (insurer documents, Oct 2026). Some plans cap cover per illness below this.

params.label: Pre-existing disease emergency cover
params.tip: Life-threatening emergencies from a declared pre-existing condition are covered in the plan or a top variant without a paid add-on. Limits are usually low.

params.label: Covid-19 covered
params.tip: Insurer states Covid-19 medical costs are covered (product page or wording, Oct 2026).

params.label: Medical deductible
params.tip: Amount you pay yourself on each medical claim (Oct 2026).

params.label: Trip / flight delay benefit
params.tip: Delay payout on the top variant (insurer documents, Oct 2026).

params.label: Checked baggage loss (USD)
params.tip: Maximum payout for total loss of checked-in baggage on the top variant (Oct 2026).

params.label: Insurer claim settlement ratio
params.tip: Insurer's health claims settled within 3 months, FY2025-26 (public disclosures via Ditto). Reflects the insurer overall, not travel claims specifically.

params.label: Insurer solvency ratio
params.tip: As at 31 Mar 2025, IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25. Regulatory minimum is 1.5x.

params.label: Max entry age
params.tip: Oldest age at which the plan can be bought (Oct 2026). Older travellers may need a medical check-up or a senior variant.

items.name: HDFC ERGO Explorer

v.trip_delay: Flight delay over 6 hrs: meals and hotel up to USD 100-300 by cover; trip delay up to USD 500

pros: Medical cover up to USD 1 million
Public rate chart: Silver USD 40K for 7 days in Europe from Rs 332 before tax (age up to 40)
Online discount and no-claim discount on Gold/Platinum
cons: Pre-existing disease cover is a paid add-on with a low cap
Small baggage and delay caps on lower covers
Medical check-up may be needed above age 70
items.best: Travellers wanting a high medical ceiling from an insurer with a strong claims record

items.name: IndusInd Travel Insurance (formerly Reliance Travel Care)

v.trip_delay: Trip delay USD 60 per day, max 6 days (Platinum)

pros: Pre-existing disease covered in life-threatening emergencies without an add-on
Covid covered in the base plan, including trip cancellation
Ages 3 months to 90 with no medical check-up
cons: USD 50 deductible on medical claims
Trip delay paid per day, not per hour
Separate Schengen plan goes only to EUR 30K/50K
items.best: Older travellers and those with declared conditions

items.name: Digit International Travel Insurance

v.trip_delay: USD 25 per 4 hrs, max USD 100; plus Rs 500-1,000 instant payout for delays over 6 hrs

pros: Automatic payout for flight delays
Claims from a smartphone
Single-day adventure activities covered
cons: Pre-existing disease cover only on Smart 360 or as an add-on, USD 5K-10K
Room rent capped at USD 1K-2K
Flight delay capped at USD 100
items.best: Tech-savvy travellers who want quick, paperless claims

items.name: SBI General Travel Insurance (Business and Holiday)

v.trip_delay: USD 200 per 12 hrs after the first 12 hrs

pros: Generous delay payout of USD 200 per 12 hours
Free 7-day automatic extension if transport is delayed
Large shared pool for travel benefits
cons: No pre-existing disease cover at all
Baggage limit is shared with other travel benefits, 5% deductible
Older 2013-era product; ages 6 months to 70 only
items.best: Business and holiday travellers without pre-existing conditions

items.name: ICICI Lombard International Travel Insurance
pros: Medical cover up to USD 500K
Platinum adds compassionate visit and hotel extension
Trip delay up to USD 500
cons: Pre-existing diseases excluded even in emergencies
Small sub-limits (dental USD 100, passport USD 50)
Baggage limit unclear: sources give USD 500 or USD 2,000
items.best: Healthy travellers who want a large insurer's brand

items.name: Care Explore

v.trip_delay: USD 25 per 4 hrs, max USD 150 (EUR 20 per 4 hrs, max EUR 120 on Europe)

pros: No maximum entry age
Region-specific plans including Europe
Pre-existing disease available as an optional benefit up to 10% of sum insured
cons: Deductible on medical claims
Inpatient sub-limits on lower variants and for ages 61+
Top medical cover unconfirmed: sources give USD 500K or USD 1M
items.best: Senior travellers who struggle to get cover elsewhere

items.name: Niva Bupa TravelAssure

v.trip_delay: USD 25-50 per 4 hrs, for delays up to 24 hrs

pros: No inpatient sub-limits on Comprehensive
Pre-existing disease emergencies covered up to USD 10K
Build-your-own plan, including adventure sports variant
cons: USD 100 medical deductible
Adult entry age 18-70
Lite variant has thin non-medical cover (USD 100 baggage)
items.best: Travellers who want flexible, customisable cover from a health specialist

items.name: Bajaj Travel Insurance (Prime / Elite / ACE / Companion)
pros: Medical cover up to USD 1 million on Prime
Companion plan covers ages up to 99
Cashless network and premium refund on early return
cons: Pre-existing disease cover low (USD 3K-5K)
Trip delay capped at USD 180
Figures from a third-party site, may lag the insurer
items.best: Elderly travellers and those wanting a high medical limit

items.name: Generali Central Jet Set Secure
pros: Cashless claims and auto trip extension up to 7 days
Many add-ons: gadgets, adventure sports, cruise
15% online and 5% family discounts
cons: Pre-existing disease cover costs extra (USD 5K-15K)
Trip delay capped at USD 240
Single trip not renewable; separate senior plan for 71-90

items.name: IFFCO Tokio Overseas Travel Protector
pros: Up to USD 1 million per incident
Built-in pre-existing disease emergency cover up to USD 20K
Schengen pricing published: 7 days from Rs 398 (Bronze) to Rs 1,703 (Platinum 1000), age up to 40
cons: Sub-limit variants cap room rent, ICU and surgery
Platinum 1000/750 only up to age 60
USD 100 medical deductible
items.best: Schengen travellers wanting high cover with built-in pre-existing disease protection

items.name: Zurich Kotak Smart Travel
pros: Schengen plans with no sub-limits
Family floater plans
Senior plans for ages 71+
cons: USD 100K per-illness cap except on Platinum Plus and Schengen plans
Pre-existing disease cover limited to acute pain relief unless add-on
Trip delay capped at USD 200; USD 50 baggage deductible
